svg.title: How one report earns an explicit readiness result
svg.desc: A report author selects one finished artifact. The validator runs required visual, functional, and browser-matrix checks against it, records ready, failed, or incomplete evidence, and informs the author's sharing decision. A policy rail states that ready requires every mandatory check to pass and not run never means passed.

g.text: Invariant / policy rail · Ready only when every mandatory check passes the same artifact · Not run ≠
